live.title.note: Page heading and document title for the Live run route.

live.points_earned.note: Label above live measured points. Unknown never becomes zero.

live.search_progress.note: Running search row. earned and max are formatted search-points measurements.

live.stop.note: Requests a graceful stop of this specific active run.

live.stop_waiting.note: Disabled stop button after a stop request; does not claim the run has ended.

live.stop_note.text: Waiting for the browser to stop. This can take a moment.
live.stop_note.note: Waiting explanation until the final run record arrives.

live.history.note: Action to inspect this finished run's details.

live.overview.note: Idle-state action to inspect tasks or start a run.

live.last_run.note: Card heading when no run is active and a previous summary exists.

live.more_details.note: Collapsed disclosure for secondary failure results, warnings, check decisions and unreadable-page diagnostics. The primary account error stays visible above it.
